124	def _validate_runtime_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
125	    if args.sample_rate <= 0:

448	def _safe_tar_members(tf: tarfile.TarFile, dest_dir: Path):
449	    """Yield only safe members for extraction into dest_dir.
450	
451	    This emulates the safety guarantees of `filter="data"` on Python < 3.12:
452	    - prevent path traversal (no entries may escape dest_dir)
453	    - skip device files
454	    """
455	    dest_dir_resolved = dest_dir.resolve()
456	    for member in tf.getmembers():
457	        # Skip device files and other special devices
458	        if member.isdev():
459	            continue
460	
461	        member_path = (dest_dir / member.name).resolve()
462	        try:
463	            member_path.relative_to(dest_dir_resolved)
464	        except ValueError:
465	            # This member would escape dest_dir (e.g., via .. or absolute path)
466	            continue
467	
468	        yield member
469

471	def _download_model(model_dir: str, model_type: str) -> None:
472	    """Download and extract the default model for the given model_type."""
473	    model_dir = Path(model_dir)
474	
475	    # ReazonSpeech Japanese model
476	    if model_type == "ja" or model_dir.name == _REAZON_JA_TARGET:
477	        url = _REAZON_JA_URL
478	        archive_name = _REAZON_JA_ARCHIVE
479	        extracted_name = _REAZON_JA_EXTRACTED
480	    # ReazonSpeech bilingual ja-en and ja-en-mls-5k (same sherpa-onnx archive)
481	    elif model_type in ("ja-en", "ja-en-mls-5k") or model_dir.name in (
482	        _REAZON_JA_EN_TARGET, _REAZON_JA_EN_MLS_TARGET
483	    ):
484	        url = _REAZON_JA_EN_URL
485	        archive_name = _REAZON_JA_EN_ARCHIVE
486	        extracted_name = _REAZON_JA_EN_EXTRACTED
487	    # Cohere Transcribe multilingual model
488	    elif model_type == "cohere_transcribe" or model_dir.name == _COHERE_TRANSCRIBE_TARGET:
489	        url = _COHERE_TRANSCRIBE_URL
490	        archive_name = _COHERE_TRANSCRIBE_ARCHIVE
491	        extracted_name = _COHERE_TRANSCRIBE_EXTRACTED
492	    # Multilingual streaming zipformer model
493	    elif model_type == "multilingual_streaming" or model_dir.name == _MULTILINGUAL_STREAMING_TARGET:
494	        url = _MULTILINGUAL_STREAMING_URL
495	        archive_name = _MULTILINGUAL_STREAMING_ARCHIVE
496	        extracted_name = _MULTILINGUAL_STREAMING_EXTRACTED
497	    # Use parakeet as the default offline model download target
498	    elif model_type == "nemo_transducer" or model_dir.name in (
499	        _PARAKEET_FP16_TARGET, _PARAKEET_INT8_TARGET
500	    ):
501	        # Choose variant based on directory name
502	        if "int8" in model_dir.name:
503	            url = _PARAKEET_INT8_URL
504	            archive_name = _PARAKEET_INT8_ARCHIVE
505	            extracted_name = _PARAKEET_INT8_EXTRACTED
506	        else:
507	            url = _PARAKEET_FP16_URL
508	            archive_name = _PARAKEET_FP16_ARCHIVE
509	            extracted_name = _PARAKEET_FP16_EXTRACTED
510	    else:
511	        url = _MODEL_URL
512	        archive_name = _MODEL_ARCHIVE
513	        extracted_name = _MODEL_EXTRACTED
514	
515	    # Download into models/ alongside the target directory
516	    models_dir = model_dir.parent
517	    models_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
518	    archive = models_dir / archive_name
519	    _info("Model not found.")
520	    # Only download if the archive isn't already fully present (valid tarfile).
521	    if archive.exists():
522	        try:
523	            with tarfile.open(archive, "r:bz2") as _tf:
524	                _tf.getmembers()
525	            _info(f"Archive already present: {archive.name}")
526	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
527	            _info("Existing archive is incomplete — resuming download…")
528	            _download_file(url, archive)
529	    else:
530	        _download_file(url, archive)
531	
532	    _info("Extracting…")
533	    try:
534	        with tarfile.open(archive, "r:bz2") as tf:
535	            if sys.version_info >= (3, 12):
536	                tf.extractall(models_dir, filter="data")
537	            else:  # pragma: no cover
538	                tf.extractall(models_dir, members=_safe_tar_members(tf, models_dir))
539	    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
540	        _error(f"Extraction failed: {exc}")
541	
542	    extracted = models_dir / extracted_name
543	    if not extracted.is_dir():
544	        _error(f"Expected extracted directory '{extracted_name}' not found.")
545	
546	    extracted.rename(model_dir)
547	    archive.unlink(missing_ok=True)
548	    _info(f"Model saved to '{model_dir}'.\n")
549

561	def _resolve_default_model(language: str, model_type: str, offline: bool) -> tuple[str, str]:
562	    """Return (model_type, model_dir_name) for omitted --model-dir."""
563	    if model_type == "ja":
564	        return model_type, _REAZON_JA_TARGET
565	    if model_type == "ja-en":
566	        return model_type, _REAZON_JA_EN_TARGET
567	    if model_type == "ja-en-mls-5k":
568	        return model_type, _REAZON_JA_EN_MLS_TARGET
569	    if model_type == "cohere_transcribe":
570	        return model_type, _COHERE_TRANSCRIBE_TARGET
571	    if model_type == "multilingual_streaming":
572	        return model_type, _MULTILINGUAL_STREAMING_TARGET
573	    if model_type == "nemo_transducer":
574	        return model_type, _PARAKEET_TARGET
575	    if model_type:
576	        return model_type, _PARAKEET_TARGET if offline else _MODEL_TARGET
577	    if language in _ASR_LANGUAGE_DEFAULTS:
578	        return _ASR_LANGUAGE_DEFAULTS[language]
579	    if offline:
580	        return model_type, _PARAKEET_TARGET
581	    return model_type, _MODEL_TARGET
582

584	def _validate_vad(vad_type: str, ten_vad_model: str, offline: bool, project_dir: Path) -> str:
585	    if not offline:
586	        return ""
587	    if vad_type not in {"silero", "ten-vad"}:
588	        _error(f"Unknown --vad-model type '{vad_type}'. Supported: silero, ten-vad.")
589	    if vad_type == "ten-vad":
590	        if ten_vad_model not in _TEN_VAD_MODEL_URLS:
591	            _error(
592	                f"Unknown --ten-vad-model '{ten_vad_model}'. "
593	                f"Supported: {', '.join(_TEN_VAD_MODEL_URLS)}."
594	            )
595	        vad_path = project_dir / "models" / ten_vad_model
596	        if not vad_path.exists():
597	            vad_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
598	            _info(f"VAD model not found, downloading {ten_vad_model}…")
599	            _download_file(_TEN_VAD_MODEL_URLS[ten_vad_model], vad_path)
600	        return str(vad_path)
601	    # silero
602	    vad_path = project_dir / "models" / "silero_vad.onnx"
603	    if not vad_path.exists():
604	        vad_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
605	        _info("VAD model not found, downloading silero_vad.onnx…")
606	        _download_file(_VAD_URL, vad_path)
607	    return str(vad_path)

610	def _safe_extract_tar(tar: tarfile.TarFile, path: Path) -> None:
611	    """Safely extract tar contents to `path`, preventing path traversal and links.
612	
613	    This emulates the behavior of `filter="data"` available in Python 3.12+,
614	    but is compatible with Python 3.8+.
615	    """
616	    base_path = path.resolve()
617	    for member in tar.getmembers():
618	        # Skip symlinks and hard links for safety.
619	        if member.issym() or member.islnk():
620	            continue
621	
622	        member_path = (base_path / member.name).resolve()
623	        try:
624	            # Ensure the target path is within the intended base directory.
625	            member_path.relative_to(base_path)
626	        except ValueError:
627	            # Path traversal attempt or otherwise outside base directory; skip.
628	            continue
629	
630	        tar.extract(member, path=base_path)
631

633	def _validate_diarization_models(
634	    seg_model: str, emb_model: str, project_dir: Path
635	) -> tuple[str, str]:
636	    """Return paths to diarization models, downloading them if necessary."""
637	    models_dir = project_dir / "models"
638	
639	    # Segmentation model
640	    if not seg_model:
641	        seg_dir = models_dir / _DIAR_SEG_EXTRACTED
642	        seg_path = seg_dir / _DIAR_SEG_MODEL_FILE
643	        if not seg_path.exists():
644	            seg_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
645	            _info("Diarization segmentation model not found, downloading…")
646	            archive = models_dir / _DIAR_SEG_ARCHIVE
647	            _download_file(_DIAR_SEG_URL, archive)
648	            _info("Extracting segmentation model…")
649	            try:
650	                with tarfile.open(archive, "r:bz2") as tf:
651	                    _safe_extract_tar(tf, models_dir)
652	            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
653	                _error(f"Extraction failed: {exc}")
654	            archive.unlink(missing_ok=True)
655	            if not seg_path.exists():
656	                _error(f"Segmentation model not found after extraction: {seg_path}")
657	            _info(f"Segmentation model saved to '{seg_path}'.")
658	        seg_model = str(seg_path)
659	    elif not Path(seg_model).exists():
660	        _error(f"Diarization segmentation model not found: {seg_model}")
661	
662	    # Embedding model
663	    if not emb_model:
664	        emb_path = models_dir / _DIAR_EMB_FILE
665	        if not emb_path.exists():
666	            models_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
667	            _info("Diarization embedding model not found, downloading…")
668	            _download_file(_DIAR_EMB_URL, emb_path)
669	            _info(f"Embedding model saved to '{emb_path}'.")
670	        emb_model = str(emb_path)
671	    elif not Path(emb_model).exists():
672	        _error(f"Diarization embedding model not found: {emb_model}")
673	
674	    return seg_model, emb_model

677	def _validate_punct(punct_model: str, project_dir: Path) -> str:
678	    """Return path to punctuation model directory, downloading if necessary."""
679	    if punct_model:
680	        if not Path(punct_model).is_dir():
681	            _error(f"Punctuation model directory not found: {punct_model}")
682	        return punct_model
683	    models_dir = project_dir / "models"
684	    punct_dir = models_dir / _PUNCT_TARGET
685	    if punct_dir.is_dir():
686	        return str(punct_dir)
687	    models_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
688	    archive = models_dir / _PUNCT_ARCHIVE
689	    _info("Punctuation model not found, downloading…")
690	    if archive.exists():
691	        try:
692	            with tarfile.open(archive, "r:bz2") as _tf:
693	                _tf.getmembers()
694	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
695	            _download_file(_PUNCT_URL, archive)
696	    else:
697	        _download_file(_PUNCT_URL, archive)
698	    _info("Extracting punctuation model…")
699	    try:
700	        with tarfile.open(archive, "r:bz2") as tf:
701	            if sys.version_info >= (3, 12):
702	                tf.extractall(models_dir, filter="data")
703	            else:  # pragma: no cover
704	                tf.extractall(models_dir, members=_safe_tar_members(tf, models_dir))
705	    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
706	        _error(f"Extraction failed: {exc}")
707	    extracted = models_dir / _PUNCT_EXTRACTED
708	    if not extracted.is_dir():
709	        _error(f"Expected punctuation model directory '{_PUNCT_EXTRACTED}' not found after extraction.")
710	    extracted.rename(punct_dir)
711	    archive.unlink(missing_ok=True)
712	    _info(f"Punctuation model saved to '{punct_dir}'.")
713	    return str(punct_dir)

716	def _validate_wav(path: str, sample_rate: int) -> None:
717	    p = Path(path)
718	    if not p.exists():
719	        _error(f"Audio file not found: {path}")
720	    try:
721	        sf = _require_soundfile()
722	        with sf.SoundFile(path) as f:
723	            if f.channels != 1:
724	                _error(
725	                    f"Audio must be mono (1 channel), got {f.channels}.\n"
726	                    f"  Convert: ffmpeg -i {path} -ar {sample_rate} -ac 1 out.wav"
727	                )
728	            if f.samplerate != sample_rate:
729	                _info(
730	                    f"Audio is {f.samplerate} Hz; resampling to {sample_rate} Hz."
731	                )
732	    except Exception as exc:
733	        _error(f"Cannot read audio file: {exc}")
734	
735	
736	def _validate_mic() -> None:
737	    try:
738	        import sounddevice as sd
739	
740	        devices = sd.query_devices()
741	        inputs = [d for d in devices if d["max_input_channels"] > 0]
742	        if not inputs:
743	            _error("No input audio device found.")
744	    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
745	        _error(f"Microphone check failed: {exc}")

748	def main() -> None:
749	    args = parse_args()
750	    _validate_runtime_args(args)
751	    # Normalize once so all downstream comparisons are case-insensitive.
752	    args.model_type = args.model_type.lower()
753	    args.language = _normalize_language(args.language)
754	
755	    # Resolve paths relative to the project root (one level above src/).
756	    project_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
757	    # Use a type-specific default dir when the user didn't pass --model-dir explicitly.
758	    if args.model_dir is None:
759	        args.model_type, model_dir_name = _resolve_default_model(
760	            args.language, args.model_type, args.offline
761	        )
762	        raw_model_dir = f"models/{model_dir_name}"
763	    else:
764	        raw_model_dir = args.model_dir
765	    model_dir = Path(raw_model_dir)
766	    if not model_dir.is_absolute():
767	        model_dir = project_dir / model_dir
768	
769	    cfg = Config(
770	        model_dir=str(model_dir),
771	        sample_rate=args.sample_rate,
772	        chunk_size=args.chunk_size,
773	        num_threads=args.threads,
774	        model_type=args.model_type,
775	        offline=args.offline,
776	        vad_type=args.vad_type,
777	        ten_vad_model=args.ten_vad_model,
778	        language=args.language,
779	        show_mic_level=args.listening,
780	        diarization=args.diarization,
781	        diarization_seg_model=args.diarization_seg_model,
782	        diarization_emb_model=args.diarization_emb_model,
783	        diarization_num_speakers=args.num_speakers,
784	        device=args.device,
785	        denoise=args.denoise,
786	        word_timestamps=args.word_timestamps,
787	        punctuation=args.punctuation,
788	        punct_model=args.punct_model,
789	    )
790	
791	    _validate_model(cfg.model_dir, cfg.model_type)
792	
793	    # Auto-detect offline-only models and switch automatically.
794	    _OFFLINE_ONLY_TYPES = {"nemo_transducer", "whisper", "nemo_ctc", "sense_voice", "moonshine", "fire_red_asr", "cohere_transcribe", "ja", "ja-en", "ja-en-mls-5k"}
795	    _OFFLINE_ONLY_NAME_PATTERNS = ("parakeet", "nemo", "whisper", "sense_voice", "moonshine", "fire_red_asr", "cohere", "reazonspeech")
796	    model_name_lower = Path(cfg.model_dir).name.lower()
797	    if not cfg.offline and (
798	        cfg.model_type in _OFFLINE_ONLY_TYPES
799	        or any(pat in model_name_lower for pat in _OFFLINE_ONLY_NAME_PATTERNS)
800	    ):
801	        _info(
802	            f"Model '{Path(cfg.model_dir).name}' is offline-only — "
803	            "enabling --offline automatically."
804	        )
805	        cfg.offline = True
806	
807	    # Remap model-type aliases that sherpa-onnx doesn't accept in from_transducer.
808	    # Use "" so sherpa-onnx auto-detects the architecture from the model files.
809	    _TRANSDUCER_AUTODETECT_ALIASES = {"ja", "ja-en", "ja-en-mls-5k", "multilingual_streaming"}
810	    if cfg.model_type in _TRANSDUCER_AUTODETECT_ALIASES:
811	        cfg.model_type = ""
812	
813	    cfg.vad_model = _validate_vad(cfg.vad_type, cfg.ten_vad_model, cfg.offline, project_dir)
814	
815	    if args.wav:
816	        for wav_path in args.wav:
817	            _validate_wav(wav_path, cfg.sample_rate)
818	    else:
819	        _validate_mic()
820	
821	    # Download punctuation model if requested.
822	    punctuator = None
823	    if cfg.punctuation:
824	        cfg.punct_model = _validate_punct(cfg.punct_model, project_dir)
825	
826	    # Validate / download diarization models if requested.
827	    diarizer = None
828	    if cfg.diarization:
829	        cfg.diarization_seg_model, cfg.diarization_emb_model = _validate_diarization_models(
830	            cfg.diarization_seg_model, cfg.diarization_emb_model, project_dir
831	        )
832	
833	    model_name = Path(cfg.model_dir).name
834	    _info(f"Loading model '{model_name}' ({cfg.num_threads} threads)…")
835	
836	    # Build models once before any batch processing.

The failing test in `test_benchmark.py` is unrelated to my changes (it tests resampy which was already replaced by soxr per the recent commit history). The ASR tests all pass.

Here's a summary of what was added:

**New model type: `parakeet-ctc-ja`**

- Maps to directory `models/parakeet-ctc-ja-int8/`
- Uses NeMo CTC recognizer (`nemo_ctc` under the hood via `OfflineRecognizer.from_ctc`)
- Auto-downloads from the sherpa-onnx release when the model directory is missing
- Offline-only (automatically enables `--offline`)

**Usage:**
```bash
sherox.asr --mic --model-type parakeet-ctc-ja
sherox.asr --wav audio.wav --model-type parakeet-ctc-ja
```

The existing `--model-type ja` (ReazonSpeech) remains the default for `--language ja` — this new model is an explicit alternative.

193	# Audio loading
194	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

196	def load_audio(path: str, target_sr: int = 16000) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
197	    """Load an audio file; convert to mono float32 and resample if needed.
198	
199	    Resampling preference order (fastest → slowest, all high-quality):
200	      1. soxr     — C-based SoX resampler (~10 ms / 30 s, HQ quality)
201	      2. scipy.signal.resample_poly — polyphase FIR with Kaiser β=14
202	    """
203	    sf = _require_soundfile()
204	    audio, sr = sf.read(path, dtype="float32", always_2d=False)
205	    if audio.ndim == 2:
206	        audio = audio.mean(axis=1)
207	
208	    if sr != target_sr:
209	        try:
210	            import soxr  # noqa: PLC0415
211	            audio = soxr.resample(audio, sr, target_sr, quality="HQ").astype(np.float32)
212	        except ImportError:
213	            from math import gcd  # noqa: PLC0415
214	            from scipy.signal import resample_poly  # noqa: PLC0415
215	            g = gcd(target_sr, sr)
216	            audio = resample_poly(
217	                audio, target_sr // g, sr // g,
218	                window=("kaiser", 14.0), padtype="line",
219	            ).astype(np.float32)
220	
221	    duration = len(audio) / target_sr
222	    return audio, duration
